updates.notes_append: UNRESOLVED 2026-09-17: the row's ed.gov URL now returns HTTP 404, and the most recent competition that could be confirmed is FY2025 (Federal Register notice of 30 October 2024, applications due 15 January 2025, an estimated $3,000,000 subject to congressional action). No FY2026 or FY2027 competition was found. A 404 is not evidence of termination (D-009), so status stays unknown — but this is the row most worth resolving next, because a dead departmental page plus no newer competition is exactly the pattern a reader would misread. Try iris.ed.gov/programs/ddra and the Federal Register.
